Rebecca Ferguson returns as Juliette Nichols in Silo Season 3, the hit Apple TV sci-fi series from Graham Yost, based on Hugh Howey’s bestselling trilogy. After surviving her forced cleaning, Juliette returns with memory loss as the underground society recovers from rebellion and faces a dangerous new threat.

Season 3 also reveals the Before Times, following journalist Helen Drew and Congressman Daniel Keene as they uncover the conspiracy behind the creation of the silos and the catastrophe that changed the world forever.

Silo Season 3 premieres July 3, 2026 on Apple TV.
